context.transcript:
information and map.
Welcome to Southridge National Park everyone.
Today's hike will take us to Diamond Sand Lake.
It isn't the shortest trail in the park, but it is a pretty easy one.
I'm glad you all brought your binoculars because it's migration season, so we're likely to see lots of interesting birds along the way.
Now, today's forecast calls for a chance of showers.
If you have a raincoat, I suggest you put it on.
We'll be leaving in about 15 minutes.
context.transcript_translation:
信息和地图。
欢迎来到 Southridge National Park 各位。
今天的徒步路线将带我们去 Diamond Sand Lake。
它不是公园里最短的步道，但却是一条相当轻松的路线。
我很高兴大家都带来了望远镜，因为现在是迁徙季节，所以沿途很可能会看到很多有趣的鸟类。
现在，今天的预报说有阵雨的可能性。
如果您带了雨衣，建议您穿上。
我们大约在 15 分钟后出发。
